def test_return_dated_t_compounds_close_t_minus_1_into_close_t(contract_sample):
    # RISK-01: r_t = ln(close_t / close_t-1), dated t, so exp(r_t) * close_t-1 == close_t.
    data = contract_sample("mdata.Prices")
    prices = _prices(data)

    returns = log_returns(prices)

    assert returns.base_date == data["dates"][0]
    assert returns.dates == tuple(data["dates"][1:])
    assert returns.tickers == tuple(data["tickers"])
    for ticker in data["tickers"]:
        closes = data["closes"][ticker]
        assert len(returns.values[ticker]) == len(closes) - 1
        rebuilt = [
            closes[i] * math.exp(r) for i, r in enumerate(returns.values[ticker])
        ]
        assert rebuilt == pytest.approx(closes[1:], rel=1e-12, abs=0)
